attributes.check1: Intelligence or Ranged or Stealth or Craft 6
attributes.name: Poisoned Bullets
attributes.powers:
Display this card; you may not do so during an encounter. After playing this card, if you have more than 2 cards that have the Ammunition trait displayed, recharge 1 of them.

While displayed, when you play a weapon that has the Firearm trait on your combat check, you may bury this card to add 1d12 and the Poison trait. You may succeed at a Craft or Stealth 8 check to recharge this card instead of burying it.
